## The original series will begin airing in January 2027
...
A brand-new trailer was released today for the Inherit the Winds anime's two-week theatrical preview run, which will commence in November 13 before the series debuts next January. As previewed in the trailer, "Namida no Kawa" by Hitsujibungaku and Quruli will serve as the theatrical preview's theme song, as well as the series' ending theme song. The pair will also perform "Kaze wo Tsugu Mono" for the series' opening theme song. Furthermore, Takaya Kamikawa joins the cast as Shinbei Umeda, a retainer of the Iwakuni Domain.
...
## Inherit the Winds Anime Advance Theatrical Screening Trailer
...
The Inherit the Winds TV anime is inspired by the first story in the popular Tachikawa Jinsuke stage play tetralogy performed by the theatre group Caramel Box since 1996. Set in the time around the Meiji Restoration, the series follows the fictional Shinsengumi soldier Jinsuke Tachikawa (voiced by Daisuke Sakuma) as he lives in a rapidly changing Japan. Inherit the Winds introduces Tachikawa as he enters the war and deals with the ramifications of the Kinmon incident. The stories are penned by playwrights Yutaka Narui and Azuki Mashiba. Tomohiro Kawamura directs the anime adaptation at Live2d Creative Studio and Drive Inc., with scripts by Yutaka Narui, character designs by Fumi Ebina and music by Shigeru Kishiba. The series will begin airing sometime in January 2027.

...
The Oishinbo manga series, which is written by Kariya and drawn by Hanasaki, has been serialized in Shogakukan’s Big Comic Spirits magazine since October 1983. It has been in an indefinite hiatus since May 2014. A total of 111 tankobon volumes have been published in Japan as of December 2014.
...

Still, with no concrete release window or date announced for the next season as of this time there is plenty of time to catch up with it all and sink into Hiromu Arakawa’s newest world.

While Avengers: Doomsday will mark the original team's last hurrah, who appeared in FOX's own adaptation of these characters, the MCU must start from a fresh slate as it slowly brings Mutants into its landscape. Notable characters like Namor and Ms. Marvel have joined the Mutant ranks so far, and major casting announcements have been made for heroes like Cyclops, Storm, and, notably, Professor Charles Xavier. Magneto will undoubtedly factor into the X-Men adaptation, especially because the figure was part of the X-Men's very first comic. He was a huge part of the FOX movies too, and yet, Marvel might have a problem on their hands. The origin story of Magneto might have to be drastically changed after years of inconsistency.
...
After those explanations were abandoned, Marvel took a new approach. They gave Magneto, or Magnus, a new name. The comics stated that Erik Magnus Lehnsherr was not Magneto's real name at all. Rather, it was a way of concealing his identity to help his escape and avoid the barbarism of the Nazis. Thus, the name that even the movies had stuck with had been changed completely. 2008's X-Men: Magneto - Testament by Grek Pak and Carmine Di Giandomenico set Magneto's history on a new course. One that may just have a massive impact on the MCU.
...
Magneto was revealed to have instead been called Max Eisenhardt, a name that the comics have since used to represent Magneto in his most complete form. This is the true identity of the Mutant, but a name that even those in Magneto's life barely know him by. It is Professor Xavier who muses that he doesn't truly feel like he knew who Max was, the innocence of the boy before the traumas that he faced, hidden away deep inside the villain. In the most recent Marvel Comics, Magneto has even reclaimed his name, perhaps reclaiming some sense of power and identity in the process, while embracing who he truly is.

cbr.com/zach-cregger-joker-batman-movie.title: Resident Evil Director Wrote a Batman Script With an Unusual Twist
cbr.com/zach-cregger-joker-batman-movie.excerpt:
Filmmaker Zach Cregger has another big hit on his hands with the successful launch of Resident Evil. Amid the new film's success, fans may be wondering how his Batman movie would have turned out if it had gotten made.
...
During a new interview for Men's Health, Cregger shared details about Henchman, his screenplay for a film set in Gotham City. It came with a unique twist, as while characters like Batman and The Joker were present, they were not the focus. The film would have instead focused on an everyman who happens to get caught up in a conflict between the Dark Knight and the Clown Prince of Crime. This is reminiscent of the new Resident Evil following a courier who stumbles into Raccoon City right when the zombie outbreak from the games begins, rather than using a powerful and established character.
...
“It’s about a normal guy," Cregger said of the script, which was the first movie screenplay he ever wrote. "It’s about a pharmacist who lives in Gotham City, and he gets accidentally sucked into this incredible power play between Batman and The Joker. And he finds himself a very integral part of something. And so, it’s a weird movie. It’s someone living on the periphery of all the stories in Gotham that we know of, and it’s about some rando. I’m not the world’s biggest Batman guy at all, but I just liked this story. I liked this character. I liked what happened to him, so it was just fun.”
...
Most comic book movies focus on popular superheroes, although some will shift the focus to villains, with characters like The Joker and Clayface getting their own movies. What's very uncommon is for a movie based on DC or Marvel comic books to keep the focus on a "normal guy" and turning the superheroes and supervillains into side characters. As the movie was not made and Cregger has moved on to other projects, it seems improbable that Henchman will ever see the light of day, though the director's fans can imagine how it might have turned out.
...
Cregger turned things around in a big way with the success of the horror flick Barbarian, his first feature film as a sole director. Last year's Weapons was a huge hit for Cregger as well, leading to his hiring to direct a new Resident Evil movie. This was a move that is working out well for Sony, as Resident Evil is now being declared as the greatest video game movie of all time.

The Solo Leveling franchise is no stranger to hiatuses, and series creator Chugong has now offered some insight into why.
...
In a newly released interview for the art book The Art of Solo Leveling, Chugong recalls some of the struggles he faced while serializing the original web novel series. Although he had the ending to Jinwoo’s story mapped out before he began writing, Chugong still ran into complications along the way. At one point, he even had to put the series on an extended hiatus to get everything organized ahead of the finale.
...
As Chugong fleshed out Solo Leveling's story chapter by chapter, he began to struggle to reconcile the new version of Jinwoo’s story with his original vision for how it would end. While the series' world-building and background lore remained steadfast, Chugong decided to remove details he felt didn’t serve the main storyline (such as the concept of the Itarim) in order to focus purely on Jinwoo’s main story arc.
...
Ultimately, this process proved difficult, especially given the rather unforgiving writing schedule for a serialized webnovel. "I remember that the story became tangled during that process of adding and removing elements," Chugong recalls, "forcing me to place the series on hiatus for a while." While he never shares exactly when this hiatus took place, there’s at least one likely period he's referring to.
...
According to Kakaopage's announcement archive, Chugong took a week-long break in early July 2017, just before the series’ final arc. It was likely during this short break that Chugong's aforementioned hiatus took place as he sought to connect all the dots ahead of the release of Chapter 233.

bleedingcool.com/tv/lanterns-has-picked-.title: Lanterns "Has Picked Up Nicely," "Approach Has Worked": Grant Morrison
bleedingcool.com/tv/lanterns-has-picked-.excerpt:
Grant Morrison posted an update on HBO's Lanterns, praising Kyle Chandler and Aaron Pierre and noting that the series "has picked up nicely."
...
With the first of the season's final three episodes hitting tonight, Chris Mundy, Damon Lindelof, and Tom King's Aaron Pierre (John Stewart) and Kyle Chandler (Hal Jordan)-starring Lanterns is winning over a whole lot of naysayers with each chapter, and that includes writer and comics great Grant Morrison. Things got off to a bit of a rocky start when Morrison called out Lindelof for a joke the latter made during a podcast about why the show wasn't called "Green Lanterns." That was followed by a less-than-stellar rundown of the series premiere by Morrison, shortly after it debuted. But now, after five episodes and the final run ahead of us, Morrison's views on the show have evolved since the August premiere.
...
In the latest edition of their Substack Xanaduum ("A Tree Made of Sparks"), Morrison shared that they're liking what they're seeing from Chandler and Pierre, and their takes on Hal Jordan and John Stewart, respectively. Though not exactly thrilled with how Ulrich Thomsen's Sinestro is being utilized ("the Hannibal Lectering of Sinestro"), Morrison noted that they're sticking with it until the end – just don't expect to hear much more from Morrison about Lanterns between now and then.
...
"Lanterns. Kyle Chandler and Aaron Pierre are great. I didn't care for the Hannibal Lectering of Sinestro, but otherwise the show has picked up nicely and the approach has worked, so good on them," Morrison wrote. To say that filmmaker Mike Flanagan is no stranger to bestselling author Stephen King's literary universe would be an understatement, to say the least. Look no further than his upcoming series take on King's classic 1974 novel Carrie, with buzz growing over Flanagan's unique vision and willingness to take some amazing creative swings. But when it comes to King, Flanagan's biggest challenge still lies ahead: his, Trevor Macy, and Intrepid Pictures' television series and film adaptation of "The Dark Tower" universe. Not only is King's fantasy-adventure-horror series epic in and of itself, but it also serves as the connective core to all of King's works. Yeah, it's big. The good news? Flanagan says the adaptation is still "very much on the table," but there have been some speed bumps along the way.
...
"To do it the way I wanna do it requires an enormous commitment from a studio," Flanagan shared with EW during an interview in support of Carrie. While Flanagan's move to Amazon after a successful creative run at Netflix didn't make matters any easier, an "enormous commitment" that Flanagan references has to do with locking down rights to certain King characters. "The way the Dark Tower universe is connected, you've got characters in there that are all over the place when it comes to studio ownership. So the development process on it has been epic. ICv2: Marvel Announces 'Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man' Season 2 Miniseries

Tie-In Ahead of Season 2 of Disney+ Series

Posted by Brigid Alverson on September 21, 2026 @ 12:46 pm CT

 

Marvel will publish a four-issue miniseries tying in with the Disney+ show Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man, set between the first season of the show, which launched in January 2025, and the second, which will launch in January 2027. The miniseries will reunite the creative team of writer Christos Gage and artist Eric Gapstur, who wrote a five-issue prequel before the show premiered (see “ Prequel Comic”). Like the first one, the new miniseries will be tied into the show’s continuity. “Just like last time, showrunner Jeff Trammell has been incredibly generous about coordinating in a way that makes our story a firm part of the show's continuity,” Gage said in a statement accompanying the announcement, adding, “It's a real pleasure to be a part of this take on Spidey that combines the feel of the Silver Age with new and exciting characters and situations. I hope I get to do it again next year!”
...
The first issue of Season 2 of Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man will go on sale on December 9, 2026, with covers by Leonardo Romero, Luciano Vecchio, and David Baldeón.

On Monday night, DC Studios co-CEO and filmmaker James Gunn took on two complaints that have been rambling around on social media. First, the series doesn't "respect" Hal Jordan, followed by the idea that the HBO and DC Studios series isn't doing anything different than DC Comics (and Marvel Comics) has done over the years: offering different creative takes.
...
Gunn on Hal Jordan Being Disrespected by Apparently Being Killed Off: "Hal's the star of TV series & he's in all the episodes so far. It's more live action screen time than all the live action screen time he's had combined throughout history. Kyle is amazing in the role. We more than respect him. We love him, despite his imperfections. Us knowing the time of his death, if that's exactly what that is, is absolutely not the same thing as killing him off right away. Hal is a big reason why the show is so popular with fans & non fans alike; sorry if you don't like it."
...
"Lanterns" Isn't Doing Anything That Hasn't Been Done Before: "I'd say avid comics readers are well aware of the differences from universe to universe. Whether it's the DCU or Earth 0 or the Absolute Universe, they all pay homage to these iconic characters, retelling their stories in different ways. Heck, even the MCU combined elements of the Ultimate universe, the 616, and original ideas. That's how these things work. But if you want the DCU to take the exact trajectory of whatever your favorite comics continuity is, that's probably not going to happen."

The original Magic Knight Rayearth is a shojo manga series written and illustrated by CLAMP. It was first serialized in Nakayoshi magazine from November 1993 to February 1995. CLAMP also wrote and published its sequel in Nakayoshi magazine from March 1995 to April 1996. Kodansha published both, with the first series running from July 1994 to March 1995 and the sequel from July 1995 to April 1996. Kodansha has published a total of 3 volumes each. The series has also inspired a 1994 anime series, an OVA that aired in 1997, and video games.

# Say Goodbye To The Fantastic Four's Original Team Before Avengers: Doomsday
...
Marvel Comics' Queen in Black event marches on, with a brand-new version of The Fantastic Four taking a leading role in the battles against Hela's symbiote alien army. This effectively splits The Fantastic Four into two incredibly formidable factions, which, if events from Queen in Black #4 are any indication, will be more than necessary.
...
Thankfully, for the Marvel universe, both factions are being led by two duos of The Fantastic Four's founding members. With Invisible Woman and Mister Fantastic leading the Fantastic Five, the Human Torch and Thing have made the choice to head up the All-New Fantastic Four to add a little leverage.
...
## Marvel Has Officially Introduced The All-New Fantastic Four
...
Following the world-altering events of Queen in Black #4 — which saw both great and wildly menacing moments take place — Marvel Comics has officially announced its two new Fantastic teams. Many would agree this was a much-needed development, as Hela has stolen the powers of the King in Black and dispatched an army of symbiote-bonded aliens to attack Earth. In order to aid Reed and Sue Richards' plight against Hela as the leaders of the Fantastic Five, the Human Torch and the Thing take to the streets to take a more ground-level approach to the ongoing war.
...
As revealed by Johnny Storm, the All-New Fantastic Four is officially made up of two best friends and two very unexpected allies.
...
- The Human Torch — a.k.a. Johnny Storm — leads this new version of Marvel Comics' very first super-team. 
- The Thing — a.k.a. Ben Grimm — returns as Johnny's best friend and most effective partner. 
- Captain Alliance — a.k.a. R'gars — is both a new addition to The Fantastic Four and Marvel Comics in general.

September 21, 2026

 By Matt Morrison 

The murderer of Hal Jordan in Lanterns is the last character fans suspect. The series offered up several possibilities in the wake of the veteran Green Lantern officer’s death. However, most of the clues point to someone outside the pool of the most likely suspects.
...
The murder of Hal Jordan in 2026 has been a part of Lanterns’ story since the first episode. However, the flash-forward in the pilot’s final scene was largely ignored for most of the series’ run, which was set during 2016. Episode 6, “Bad Optics,” returns to the modern day, with John Stewart now a successful architect trying to sell deluxe panic rooms in the wake of Metropolis’ destruction in the Superman movie.
...
Stewart reluctantly returns to Rushville, Nebraska, after being tricked into seeking out Hal Jordan, who moved back to the town after being released from prison. Stewart ends their conversation at a local diner by punching Jordan and breaking his nose. However, Stewart returns to Rushville again after being called by Sheriff Kerry Kane and informed Jordan was just murdered.
...

...

John Stewart is also a likely suspect, which is why he conceals that he met Jordan before his death and broke his nose. Even Jordan’s mentor Sinestro is part of the suspect pool, as Guy Gardner reveals Sinestro recently escaped his deep space prison.  In Transformers #39, the acclaimed creator of The Walking Dead and Invincible, Robert Kirkman — never afraid to push the envelope for readers and viewers — is taking Optimus Prime to the limit, and potentially well beyond, pitting him against an unknown superpowerful opponent he'll have to take down before he's the one getting his Spark blown out.

# M!LK『超巡!超条先輩』OPテーマ担当でPV解禁「ザッツ!超常」 

 5人組ダンスボーカルグループ・ M!LKが、テレビアニメ『超巡！超条先輩』（カンテレ・フジテレビ系で10月6日放送スタート）のオープニングテーマを担当することが発表された。曲名は「ザッツ！超常」となり、オープニングテーマを使用した第2弾メインPVも解禁された。 

M!LK『超巡！超条先輩』OPテーマ担当 

写真ページを見る

この記事の写真はこちら（全8枚）

 第2弾メインPVでは、初解禁となる「ザッツ！超常」の曲調に合わせて作品の世界観を展開。冒頭はフィルム映画のようなアンニュイな雰囲気が作品を包み込むが、オープニングテーマ「ザッツ！超常」が流れると同時に一転。作品全体がハイテンポな超能力ポリスコメディとして疾走感のある映像となっている。 

『超巡！超条先輩』場面カット 

 また、エンディングテーマは、は平均年齢20歳の若手バンド・至福ぽんちょが担当。楽曲タイトルは「またあした」に決定した。 

『超巡！超条先輩』EDテーマ担当 

 同作は、週刊少年ジャンプで連載していた最強（？）バディが平和を守る、超能力ポリスコメディ。読心術や千里眼、テレパシーといったありとあらゆる超能力を駆使する犯罪捜査のスペシャリスト「超条巡」、柔道の有段者でその怪力からゴリラの異名をもつ新米警官「一本木直」の2人が今日も珍宿の平和を守る。

Number_i（平野紫耀、神宮寺勇太、岸優太）がきょう23日、トリプルAサイドシングル「REBON／BUGS LIFE／DIGITAL GIRL」をリリース。USのプロデューサー＆監督で制作された表題曲の1曲「DIGITAL GIRL」のビジュアライザーが公開された。

fleecs_and_seeley_reunite_the_princess_m.headline: The Princess Murders
fleecs_and_seeley_reunite_the_princess_m.summary: Image Comics announced the new creator‑owned series The Princess Murders by Tony Fleecs and Tim Seeley debuting in December.

alice_queen_hearts_zenescope_december_so.headline: Wonderland Rebirth (One Shot)
alice_queen_hearts_zenescope_december_so.summary: Zenescope Comics' December 2026 solicit introduces Alice as the new Queen of Hearts in the one-shot "Wonderland Rebirth."
highlights: Alice becomes the Queen of Hearts of Wonderland, driving a dark plot to dominate the realm
Linnea, heir to the Queen of Spades, battles Alice to stop her plan
Written by Joe Brusha and Chas! Pangburn with art by Saint Yak, released December 16, 2026
alice_queen_hearts_zenescope_december_so.why_it_matters: The story reimagines classic Alice characters, offering fresh conflict for fans of Zenescope's Grimm Fairy Tales universe.

onepiece_elbaph_arc_finale_2026_trailer.headline: One Piece Episode 1180 Trailer – Elbaph Arc Finale
onepiece_elbaph_arc_finale_2026_trailer.summary: A teaser trailer for One Piece Episode 1180, the season finale of the Elbaph Arc, was released confirming its streaming debut on September 27 2026.
highlights: The trailer reveals the episode title “Elbaph in Despair – Diabolical Covenant, ‘Domi Reversi’

The episode caps the first phase of the Elbaph Arc, ending the 2026 seasonal batch of 26 episodes

dc_batman_knightfall_quest_2026_trailer.headline: Batman: Knightfall Part 2 – Knightquest
dc_batman_knightfall_quest_2026_trailer.summary: DC Studios released the first trailer for the R‑rated animated sequel Batman: Knightfall Part 2 – Knightquest.
highlights: The trailer reveals Jean‑Paul Valley/Azrael taking up the Batman mantle after Bruce Wayne is broken by Bane
Jeff Wamester directs the film from a screenplay by Jeremy Adams
Anson Mount, Michael Mando, and Pablo Schreiber reprise their voice roles as Bruce Wayne, Bane, and Azrael respectively

marvel_s_daredevil_born_again_officially.headline: Daredevil: Born Again
marvel_s_daredevil_born_again_officially.summary: Season 3 will be the final season of Daredevil: Born Again, ending the live‑action MCU series on Disney+.
highlights: The Hollywood Reporter confirmed Season 3 will be the last batch of episodes
Showrunner Dario Scardapane’s contract was not renewed, meaning he won’t helm the final season
Season 3 is expected to premiere in spring 2027, with promotion likely at NYCC in October
Returning Defenders characters—including Luke Cage, Iron Fist, and Elektra—are slated for the final season
marvel_s_daredevil_born_again_officially.why_it_matters: It marks the end of Marvel’s live‑action TV era on Disney+, reshaping the MCU’s television strategy.

demon_slayer_infinity_castle_confirms_hu.headline: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle I
demon_slayer_infinity_castle_confirms_hu.summary: The first Infinity Castle film will stream on Hulu and Disney+ starting September 28, 2026.
highlights: Streaming debut on Hulu in the U.S. and Disney+ internationally
Features both Japanese and English audio tracks
Provides a convenient way to catch up on previous Demon Slayer arcs available on Hulu
demon_slayer_infinity_castle_confirms_hu.why_it_matters: Makes the blockbuster film easily accessible for fans who missed its theatrical run.

vengeance_sincerely_your_broken_saintess.headline: With Vengeance, Sincerely, Your Broken Saintess Season 2
vengeance_sincerely_your_broken_saintess.summary: A third teaser trailer and the main theme song for the second season have been released, confirming its October 1, 2026 debut in Japan.
highlights: The second season will premiere on October 1, 2026 in Japan
Theme song "Kareinaru Revenger" performed by Juice=Juice is featured in the new trailer
Saya Fukase takes over directing duties from Chisaki, with IMAGICA Infos / Imageworks Studio handling animation production
Returning main voice cast includes Asami Seto, Soma Saito, Momo Asakura, and others
vengeance_sincerely_your_broken_saintess.why_it_matters: The trailer reveals new plot directions and confirms the continuation of the popular fantasy romance series for fans awaiting the sequel.

street_fighter_live_action_trailer_2026_.headline: Street Fighter (Live‑Action Film)
street_fighter_live_action_trailer_2026_.summary: The new trailer showcases the film’s recreation of iconic game moves and reveals its ensemble cast.
highlights: Dragonlash Kick, Shoryuken, Spinning Bird Kick and many other signature attacks appear in the trailer
Kitao Sakurai directs the film starring Andrew Koji as Ryu, Noah Centineo as Ken, and Callina Liang as Chun‑Li
The movie is scheduled to open in theaters on October 16, 2026
street_fighter_live_action_trailer_2026_.why_it_matters: Fans get a first look at how the beloved Capcom franchise’s combat style is translated to the big screen.

k_manga_no_clipping_my_way_supremacy_man.headline: No-Clipping My Way to Supremacy Manga added to K Manga
k_manga_no_clipping_my_way_supremacy_man.summary: Kodansha's K Manga platform announced it will simulpub Yui Hata's manga adaptation of Nikita Kitagawa's No-Clipping My Way to Supremacy.
highlights: The manga will be added as a simulpub title on K Manga
The story follows Henri, a weak boy who uses the "Evade" skill to bypass labyrinth walls for rewards
The original web novel debuted on Shōsetsuka ni Narō in February 2021 and light novels launched in June 2022
The manga previously ran in Shōnen Magazine R and moved to Magazine Pocket before its 12th volume release on July 9
k_manga_no_clipping_my_way_supremacy_man.why_it_matters: The addition expands K Manga's catalog with a popular web‑novel adaptation, giving fans immediate access to new chapters.

netflix_s_live_action_quiztopia_series_u.headline: Quiztopia Live-Action Series
netflix_s_live_action_quiztopia_series_u.summary: Netflix will debut its eight‑episode live‑action adaptation of the 1993‑1995 manga "Kokumin Quiz" on December 17, 2026.
highlights: Teaser trailer and expanded cast of 16 actors were revealed, including Takayuki Yamada as host KK
Directed by Teruyuki Yoshida, who also co‑writes the script with Maggy
The series will premiere globally on Netflix, with a full‑season drop on December 17, 2026
netflix_s_live_action_quiztopia_series_u.why_it_matters: It brings a cult 1990s manga to a worldwide audience, marking one of the most ambitious dystopian live‑action projects for Netflix.

akira_failing_love_manga_circulation_glo.headline: Akira Failing in Love
akira_failing_love_manga_circulation_glo.summary: Shinta Harekawa's Akira Failing in Love manga has surpassed 1 million copies in circulation worldwide.
highlights: Over 1 million copies in circulation globally as announced in Weekly Shonen Sunday combined issue 42/43 on September 16, 2026
Viz Media released the fourth English volume on September 8, 2026
The series debuted in Weekly Shonen Sunday in August 2024 and has reached its eighth Japanese volume
The manga’s success highlights strong international demand for new shōnen romance titles
akira_failing_love_manga_circulation_glo.why_it_matters: Reaching the million‑copy milestone signals significant global popularity for a relatively new shōnen romance series.

lanterns_just_revealed_how_the_dcu_is_re.headline: Lanterns (2026)
lanterns_just_revealed_how_the_dcu_is_re.summary: Episode 6 of the HBO series Lanterns deepens the DCU tie‑ins by showing John Stewart’s new role as an architect designing panic‑room shelters referencing recent DC movies.
highlights: Episode 6 “Bad Optics” reveals John Stewart has become a renowned architect building city‑wide panic‑room networks
The episode directly references James Gunn’s Superman (dimensional rift in Metropolis) and The Suicide Squad (Starro threat)
Lanterns continues its 2026 timeline, ten years after the Rushville battle that made Green Lanterns pariahs
The series airs on HBO and streams on HBO Max, positioning it within the broader DCU continuity
lanterns_just_revealed_how_the_dcu_is_re.why_it_matters: The episode provides concrete narrative links between the Lanterns series and the expanding DCU film slate, answering fan questions about cross‑title continuity.

the_eye_collector_preview_no_windows_no_.headline: The Eye Collector #4
the_eye_collector_preview_no_windows_no_.summary: Image Comics' The Eye Collector #4, written by Jonathan Ball with art by Lyndon Radchenka and GMB Chomichuk, hits stores on September 23, 2026.
highlights: Written by Jonathan Ball and illustrated by Lyndon Radchenka and GMB Chomichuk
Features Clara confronting a windowless house filled with eyeballs to rescue her friend Nathan
Available in stores on Wednesday, September 23, 2026 for $3.99
the_eye_collector_preview_no_windows_no_.why_it_matters: The issue continues the series' unsettling horror narrative, appealing to fans of atmospheric indie comics.

marvel_spy_series_2026.headline: Marvel Greenlights Spy Thriller Series (working title Zodiac)
marvel_spy_series_2026.summary: Marvel Studios announced it is developing a new spy‑thriller series codenamed Zodiac for the MCU.
highlights: The series is a spy thriller returning Marvel to the espionage genre
The working title "Zodiac" references both a villain group and Life Model Decoy versions from the comics
The project is linked to the upcoming VisionQuest storyline and could explore S.H.I.E.L.D.‑related espionage
The Hollywood Reporter broke the news, but no further details have been released
marvel_spy_series_2026.why_it_matters: It signals Marvel’s intent to revive the spy corner of the MCU and could reintroduce S.H.I.E.L.D.-style storytelling.

daredevil_born_again_season3_end.headline: Stephen Amell Instagram Tease Sparks Arrow Return Rumors
daredevil_born_again_season3_end.summary: Stephen Amell posted a cryptic Instagram video featuring a Green Arrow wanted poster, prompting fan speculation about his possible return to the role.

The post has generated widespread fan discussion about a possible cameo or new DC project

jojo_steel_ball_run_trailer_2026.headline: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run

jojo_steel_ball_run_trailer_2026.why_it_matters: The trailer signals the continuation of a long‑awaited adaptation, re‑engaging the franchise’s global fanbase.

Sumire Morihoshi joins the cast as new character Penem

sequel_s_biggest_horror_movie_just_got_a.why_it_matters: It continues the acclaimed sci‑fi franchise with returning talent and a fresh storyline for fans.

ani_one_asia_licenses_iceblade_sorcerer_.headline: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World Season 2

Opening theme "Diamond Dust" performed by Sizuk

grand_blue_4th_season_production.headline: Foodies
grand_blue_4th_season_production.summary: Kodansha’s Comic Days platform posted the final chapter of Tadashi Agi and Jun Nakanishi’s Foodies manga on September 16, 2026, ending the series.

Foodies launched on Comic Days in August 2025 and has released four compiled volumes, the latest on July 17, 2026
grand_blue_4th_season_production.why_it_matters: The conclusion wraps up a popular gourmet‑themed series by prolific writer Tadashi Agi, offering fans closure and free access to the finale.

batman_knightfall_part2_trailer.headline: The Avengers – Deleted Scene “Steve Rogers: A Man Out of Time”
batman_knightfall_part2_trailer.summary: A three‑minute deleted scene from The Avengers, revealed on the 2012 Blu‑ray release, provides the original setup for Steve’s emotional arc that was later re‑created in Captain America: The Winter Soldier.

batman_knightfall_part2_trailer.why_it_matters: The deleted scene illustrates how the MCU had to rebuild a key emotional moment in a later movie, highlighting the importance of cut footage in shaping the franchise’s storytelling.

dc_robins_casting_movie.why_it_matters: It marks a major addition to the DC Elseworlds animated lineup, focusing on the iconic Robins and their divergent paths.

Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Releases Creditless Twelfth Ending Featuring "Aoi Yume" Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its twelfth ending, featuring the song “Aoi Yume” by Mori Tsubasa. The song was used in Episodes 140-153, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.
The release follows yesterday’s release of the eleventh ending, featuring the song “Smile for…” by Ueto Aya. The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.
These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the latest entry below.
The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.
The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. publication_fingerprints.event_text:
The Savage Sword of Conan: The Original Comics Omnibus Vol. 8 Conan the Barbarian has just made his triumphant return with an exciting new release perfect for fans of the sword-and-sorcery icon. A stunning eighth new omnibus is now on sale from Titan Comics.
The Savage Sword of Conan: The Original Comics Omnibus Vol.8 was released on Sept. 8 with over one thousand pages of digitally remastered artwork and a host of bonus material. The high-quality release collects Savage Sword of Conan (1974) #102-116 as well as Marvel Comics Super Special (1977) #35 in a beautiful and deluxe hardcover format. It picks up the story directly from where the seventh omnibus left off, so Conan fans looking to complete their collection will definitely want to pick up the new release, which has a suggested retail price of $150.
Renowned Conan the Barbarian Illustrator Returns for New Omnibus Release
Titan and Penguin Random House's listing for the Original Comics Omnibus Vol. 8 promises unseen bonus material, a section of "rarely seen artwork" as well as an all-new introduction from Conan comics legend, Gary Kwapisz. Known for his detailed artwork that brought some of Conan's most savage scenes to life, Kwapisz worked not only on The Savage Sword of Conan but also Titan Comics released a deluxe hardcover omnibus collecting Savage Sword of Conan #102‑116 and Marvel Super Special #35 on Sept. Vanguard will+Dress anime's first season, which premiered in July 2022, is considered the third overall season of the D Series. The series' sixth season is the Cardfight!! Vanguard Divinezanime, which debuted in Japan in January 2024. Cardfight!! Vanguard Divinez Season 2 debuted in July 2024 as the overall seventh season.

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
2026 World Webtoon Awards Announces 20 Finalists, Opens Global Reader Vote Korea's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism (MCST) and the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA) announced on Thursday the 20 finalists for the 2026 World Webtoon Awards.
Now in their third year, the awards will accept online votes from readers worldwide from September 17 to October 19. Judges' scores and reader votes will each account for 50% of the final score.
This year's awards received 7,318 nominations from 4,038 fans worldwide, with 941 works submitted in total.
For the first time, the awards will also offer cash prizes. The grand prize winner will receive 15 million won (about US$10,700), while the Judges' Award winner will receive 13 million won (about US$9,400) and other main award winners will receive 10 million won (about US$7,200) each.
The awards ceremony will take place on December 3 at Starfield Library in COEX Mall, Seoul, as part of the World Webtoon Festival, which runs from December 2 to 6.

Tetsu Kariya and Akira Hanasaki’s long-running Oishinbo cooking manga series is receiving a new TV anime adaptation titled Shin Oishinbo. The new anime project was announced during a stage event at ABEMA Anime Festival 2026 celebrating Shin-Ei Animation’s 50th anniversary.
...
The Oishinbo manga series, which is written by Kariya and drawn by Hanasaki, has been serialized in Shogakukan’s Big Comic Spirits magazine since October 1983. It has been in an indefinite hiatus since May 2014. A total of 111 tankobon volumes have been published in Japan as of December 2014.
...
The manga previously inspired a TV anime series from Shin-Ei Animation from 1988 to 1992, as well as two anime films from Studio Deen in 1992 and 1993, respectively. A live-action film adaptation was also released in 1996. The long-running Oishinbo cooking manga will receive a new TV anime adaptation titled Shin Oishinbo. Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider‑Man Season 2 Prequel Comic Marvel Comics has revealed season two of Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man will receive a four-issue prequel comic ahead of its premiere next year. Writer Christos Gage and artist Eric Gapstur, who previously teamed up on the prequel for the first season of the animated Disney+ series in 2024, will reunite for this installment, which picks up after the finale, when Norman Osborn (voiced by Colman Domingo) obtained a sample of a symbiote.
The full synopsis says, “Your favorite web-slinger is back! Peter Parker is ready to save the world thwip by thwip! But things aren’t perfect. He’s been drifting away from his friends. And Norman Osborn may be out of the spider business, but Harry doesn’t think things are over just yet. Something’s happening at Oscorp, and Spidey and his friends need to figure out what it is!”
Gage comments, “I’m beyond excited to return to the world of Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man! Just like last time, showrunner Jeff Trammell has been incredibly generous about coordinating in a way that makes our story a firm part of the show’s continuity.”
He adds, “Best of all, Eric Gapstur returns on art, and while he was great before, he’s leveled up… wait until Marvel Comics will publish a four‑issue prequel comic for season 2 of the animated series, debuting with issue #1 on December 9, 2026. Writ

The new R-rated movie continues the story begun in Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall, which released in August.
As seen in the trailer, Knightquest picks up after Batman and Bane's brutal fight that left Bruce Wayne with a broken back. In the aftermath, Bane declares dominion over Gotham City and releases many of Batman's greatest villains back into the public. To fight back, Bruce passes the mantle to another, Jean-Paul Valley, the religiously zealous vigilante known as Azrael, which comes as a disappointing shock to both Nightwing and Robin.
In the trailer, Azrael dishes out ruthless, brutal, violent justice to criminals, first in Batman's traditional cape and cowl before transitioning to a suit of Batman armor. Check out the trailer below.

Quiztopia Live-Action Series Netflix revealed a teaser trailer, more cast members. and the December 17 global premiere for Quiztopia, its leight-episode ive-action series of Reiichi Sugimoto and Shinichi Katō's Kokumin Quiz (National Quiz) manga, on Monday.
Masahiro Takashima as as Commander Murakoshi, who leads the Reward and Punishment Squad responsible for carrying out penalties determined by the quiz results
Eiko Koike as Shoko Kamijo, the producer behind Quiztopia
Riko Ishida as Marii, a mysterious girl intent on killing KK
Kana Kurashina as Ayako, Mari's mother and a central figure in the story;
Kōji Seto as Seiji Nanbara, an activist plotting Quiztopia's downfall
Renji Ishibashi as Takeshi Gokumazawa, the Prime Minister of Japan
The story takes place in an alternate Japan where Quiztopia, a National Quiz show, has become the country's supreme governing authority. Under the National Quiz Law, any contestant who survives the quiz can have virtually any wish granted by the government — wealth, fame, the death of an enemy, the erasure of a criminal record, even ownership of a national landmark. publication_fingerprints.headline: Akira Failing in Love
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Akira Failing in Love Akira returns to the countryside for high school with a plan to win the heart of her childhood crush! They're both fools in love… because she's too dense to figure out he likes her back!
Harekawa launched the manga in Weekly Shonen Sunday in August 2024. Shogakukan published the manga's first compiled book volume in December 2024, and the eighth volume on September 16. Viz Media published the manga's fourth volume on September 8.
Kadokawa published one compiled book volume of Senpai, This Can't Be Love! in July 2019. Yen Pressreleased the manga in English in June 2024.
Kadokawa published the first volume of Sempai! Danjite Koi de wa! Brush up sequel manga in September 2020, and the second volume in May 2023. Yen Press released the sequel manga's first volume in December 2024.
Harekawa launched the Three Exorcism Siblings (Tengu Barai no San Kyōdai) manga in Coamix's Web Comic Zenyon in 2021. Coamix published the manga's first volume in 2022, and the seventh and final volume in September 2023. Titan Comicslicensed the manga and published the fourth volume in English on July 28.

publication_fingerprints.headline: The Avengers – Deleted Scene “Steve Rogers: A Man Out of Time”
publication_fingerprints.event_text: The Avengers – Deleted Scene “Steve Rogers: A Man Out of Time” The Avengers opened on May 4th, 2012 and finished its run at just over $1.52 billion, which at the time made the question of what Marvel had left on the cutting room floor an unusually interesting one. The answer arrived that September, when the Blu-ray landed carrying just under fifteen minutes of deleted and extended […] A three‑minute deleted scene from The Avengers, revealed on the 2012 Blu‑ray release, provides the original setup for Steve’s emotional arc that was later re‑created in Captain America: The Winter Soldier. The scene shows Steve Rogers reviewing deceased teammates’ files, including a live‑address for Peggy Carter It was included on the September 2012 Blu‑ray as part of fifteen minutes of deleted material The payoff of the scene appears in the theatrical cut via the waitress Beth, but the setup was missing until the later film Blu‑ray September 2012
